invariants.rationale: The method returns the result of JavaHoodieIndexFactory.createIndex(config) which is expected to produce a non-null HoodieIndex instance.
config is passed as an argument and immediately used as a parameter, indicating it is expected to be non-null.
context is passed as a parameter and used immediately; null values are typically not expected in this pattern.
getIndex returns a HoodieIndex, and result is expected to be an instance of HoodieIndex or a subclass thereof.
The result of the method is exactly what is returned by JavaHoodieIndexFactory.createIndex(config).
